    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AegisExhaust
    Feeds application-level operational signals (retries, retry exhaustion, circuit trips) into a Cockroach Aegis AegisClient as AppEvents.
    CloudClient
    Client for the CockroachDB Cloud control-plane API (part of Cockroach Continuum): list clusters and configure metric export.
    CloudClient.Cluster
    A CockroachDB Cloud cluster (control-plane view).
    CloudClient.Config
    Configuration for the Cloud client.
    CloudClient.MetricExportConfig
    Metric-export configuration; settings holds target-specific fields.
    CloudClient.MetricExportTarget
    A Cloud metric-export sink.
    CloudClient.VirtualCluster
    A Cockroach virtual cluster.
    CloudHealth
    Health probe for the Cockroach Continuum Cloud control plane.
    ContinuumAegisFactory
    AegisFactory provider registered via META-INF/services.
    ContinuumCloudFactory
    Factory for CloudClient: returns a SimulatedCloudClient when the client is disabled or has no API key, otherwise an HttpCloudClient.
    ContinuumMcpFactory
    Factory for McpClient: returns a SimulatedMcpClient when the client is disabled or has no endpoint, otherwise an HttpMcpClient.
    HttpAegisClient
    HTTP-backed Cockroach Aegis client.
    HttpCloudClient
    HTTP-backed CloudClient using a service-account Bearer token.
    HttpCloudClient.Response
    An HTTP response: status code and (text) body.
    HttpCloudClient.Transport
    A pluggable HTTP transport: (method, url, headers, body) -> response.
    HttpMcpClient
    HTTP-backed McpClient speaking the MCP Streamable HTTP transport (spec 2025-06-18).
    HttpMcpClient.Response
    An HTTP response: status code, headers, and (text) body.
    HttpMcpClient.Transport
    A pluggable HTTP transport: (method, url, headers, body) -> response.
    McpAegisClient
    Adapts an McpClient to the AegisClient SPI.
    McpAegisClient.ToolNames
    Maps Aegis operations to the tool names an MCP server advertises.
    McpClient
    Minimal client for the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
    McpClient.CallResult
    The result of a tools/call.
    McpClient.Config
    Configuration for an MCP client.
    McpClient.Content
    One content block of a tool-call result.
    McpClient.Tool
    A tool advertised by an MCP server.
    MetricExport
    Typed builders for the three metric-export sinks.
    PlenumStorageInsightsFactory
    StorageInsightsFactory provider registered via META-INF/services so Crdb.storage(ds) resolves to StorageInsightsImpl.
    SimulatedAegisClient
    In-memory Cockroach Aegis backend for development and tests.
    SimulatedCloudClient
    In-memory CloudClient for development and tests.
    SimulatedMcpClient
    In-memory McpClient for development and tests.
    SimulatedMcpClient.Call
    A recorded tools/call.
    StorageInsightsImpl
    Cockroach Plenum storage insights over customer-safe SQL surfaces.
    VirtualClusterManager
    Manages Cockroach virtual-cluster lifecycle over a SQL connection using the CREATE / SHOW / DROP VIRTUAL CLUSTER statements (these require a Continuum-enabled cluster).
    VirtualClusterManager.SqlExecutor
    The minimal SQL surface the manager needs.
